label: Global mirror image and global handedness: a world map σ and a world feature H that it reverses
term: global mirror image (σ) and global handedness (H)
definition: HandednessReversedAt σ H w := H (σ w) ↔ ¬ H w, for a map σ : W → W on the frame's worlds (the global mirror) and a world feature H : W → Prop (global spatial handedness: the actual-handed arrangement obtains). The mirror image of w has the opposite handedness. Here σ is any world map; its two consequential readings are separate senses with distinct Lean types in disambiguation dec35f6f (term MIRROR): MIRROR_1, spatial reflection P (DEF 567674e6, SpatialReflection), and MIRROR_2, CPT conjugation (DEF 7147bcb5, CPTConjugation). Both reverse spatial handedness. The registered mirror argument uses MIRROR_2 through the CPT-sense premises at τ.image; the generic declarations and the fork certificate are untagged and cover any map. Both σ and H are explicitly identified PRIMITIVE parameters of TruthCore.Modal.MirrorCollapse; nothing in Lean says which features σ preserves. Preservation enters only through the premise EssentialTruthsPreservedByMirrorAt.
note: Stipulated for #2145 lane M (owner question 2026-11-27; docs/notes/simplicity-collapse-555.md, section on the relation-of-reason account and the mirror-world rule). Physics background, navigation only and no attributed claim: the weak interaction is not invariant under spatial reflection P (Wu et al. 1957; V−A coupling), nor under CP; local Lorentz-invariant quantum field theory is invariant under CPT. So on dispositional essentialism the P-image of the actual world violates the law-grounding natures of creaturely kinds (option 1 at a creature), while the CPT image does not. The owner's left/right example survives as the CPT-mirror. Leibniz–Clarke (sourced statement 7dd2af35 concerns translation, not reflection) and Kant's incongruent counterparts are navigation only. A relationalist about orientation identifies a world with its global mirror image (σ w = w); then HandednessReversedAt fails for every H. Distinct from translation (TruthCore.Space.TranslationBoundary), which preserves orientation, and from a value tie between qualitatively different arrangements, which a qualitative rule can break.

formal_gap.meaning: σ maps each world to its global mirror image (any world map; the P and CPT readings are the senses MIRROR_1 and MIRROR_2 of disambiguation dec35f6f); H holds at a world when its spatial arrangement has the actual handedness. A model supplies both; Lean fixes only their types.
examples: A world containing one left hand and nothing else; its P-image contains one right hand.
The CPT conjugate of the actual world: every chiral molecule replaced by the antimatter molecule of opposite handedness, the history run in reverse.
exclusions: A translation or rotation, which preserves handedness.
A world that differs qualitatively from w (a different arrangement of relations), even if equally good.
Handedness relative to a part of the same world (this hand relative to that one), which the mirror preserves.
open_obligations: Whether global handedness is a genuine feature of a world (orientation substantivalism) or nothing (relationalism): the premise HandednessReversedAt is what the relationalist denies.
Which features σ preserves: entered only for essential truths, through EssentialTruthsPreservedByMirrorAt; under the P reading that premise is doubtful on dispositional essentialism.
